title: The text describes a court case involving Chief Falilat Adeniyi Adegeye, who was accused of assaulting her husband's wife, Chief (Mrs) Remi Moses Adeniyi Adegeye, by biting her. The case was first arraigned in 1996 and the accused pleaded not guilty. The magistrate found the evidence of the three witnesses, including the complainant and a medical doctor, to be incontrovertible and held that Falilat actually bit and assaulted the complainant inside her husband's office at Jibowu, Yaba. The magistrate dismissed Falilat's defense and described her behavior as uncivilized and inhuman. The case was later re-arraigned in 2000 and the accused was granted bail in the sum of N20,000 with one surety.
